title: Late.sh – a command-line Clubhouse for computer people
summary: Late.sh is a command-line based real-time audio chat platform that brings the Clubhouse social audio experience directly to the terminal, allowing developers to participate in voice conversations without leaving their command-line workflow.
problem_solved: Provides developers with a distraction-free, terminal-native audio chat platform for real-time voice conversations without needing a browser-based GUI.
why_valuable: Enables developers to participate in social audio discussions directly from their terminal, maintaining their workflow efficiency while enjoying real-time voice interaction with the tech community.
